facts.text: The resort is located in a mangrove forest very near large beaches with fine, white sand.
facts.excerpt: Located in an incredible mangrove forest very near huge beaches with fine, white sand, this all-inclusive luxury resort guarantees a truly unique stay.

facts.text: Paradisus Playa del Carmen is an all-inclusive resort.
facts.excerpt: Located in an incredible mangrove forest very near huge beaches with fine, white sand, this all-inclusive luxury resort guarantees a truly unique stay.

facts.text: The resort has a water park, lagoon-style pools, an activities pool and a swim-up bar.
facts.excerpt: Our resort features a fun water park, two lagoon-style pools, an activities pool, and a swim-up bar to cool off at any time.

facts.text: The YHI Spa offers body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, essential oils and local ingredients.
facts.excerpt: Be pampered with body and facial treatments made with Mexican honey, essential oils and local ingredients.

facts.text: YHI Spa is certified by Wellness for Cancer to provide personalized wellness services to people with cancer.
facts.excerpt: YHI Spa is certified by the prestigious Wellness for Cancer organization to provide personalized wellness services to people suffering from cancer.

facts.text: Family Concierge offers exclusive services and benefits designed for the whole family.
facts.excerpt: Discover the exclusive services and benefits for Family Concierge guests designed for the whole family.

facts.text: The Family Concierge Junior Suite Swim Up has direct access to the pool from the terrace.
facts.excerpt: An elegant suite with direct access to the pool from the terrace, equipped with the most exclusive Family Concierge benefits.

facts.text: The Suite Nature View is a one-bedroom suite with a whirlpool tub on a garden-view terrace.
facts.excerpt: Relax in this One Bedroom Suite and enjoy the peace and serenity in the whirlpool tub on the terrace with garden views.

facts.text: The Junior Suite Nature View has tropical-style furniture and a private terrace with garden views.
facts.excerpt: Tropical-style furniture, state-of-the-art technology, and endless extraordinary details. As well as a private terrace with views of the beautiful gardens.

facts.text: Kids can take part in games and experiments that stimulate their curiosity and imagination.
facts.excerpt: Kids will also enjoy endless adventures and take part in exciting games and experiments that stimulate their curiosity and imagination.

facts.text: A family party with music, snacks and bubbles is held daily in the resort's water park.
facts.excerpt: It's time to have fun with the whole family at this party full of surprises, music, events, snacks and bubbles. An event not to be missed. It is held daily in our water park.

facts.text: An offsite experience offers a yoga class at a Mayan cenote in the jungle.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the stunning views of a Mayan cenote located in the heart of the jungle. While you participate in an exclusive yoga class.

facts.text: Beaches, coral reefs, cenote pools and Mayan ruins are found in nearby Playa del Carmen.
facts.excerpt: Beaches, coral reefs, crystal-clear cenote pools and inspiring Mayan ruins await you in nearby Playa del Carmen.

facts.text: The resort has direct access to the beach.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to the beach

facts.text: Kanna Beach Club is a beachfront restaurant with Bali beds on the sand and a DJ on weekends.
facts.excerpt: Relax in Bali beds on soft sand, with a DJ spinning tunes on weekends.

facts.text: Cielo serves contemporary Mexican cuisine with a live-cooking quesadilla station.
facts.excerpt: Succulent contemporary Mexican cuisine with a special live cooking quesadilla station.

facts.text: The resort holds AAA 4 Diamond certification.
facts.excerpt: AAA 4 Diamond Certification

facts.text: The hotel has been named a Committed Queer Destinations Hotel.
facts.excerpt: This hotel has been named a Committed Queer Destinations Hotel.

facts.text: The resort hosts weddings through Romance by Paradisus.
facts.excerpt: Make the wedding of your dreams come true in a resort with a wide range of options. Choose elegance, distinction and lots of love to celebrate the most important event in your life at Paradisus Playa del Carmen.

facts.text: The fitness center offers Pilates, yoga, spinning, wellness and massage classes.
facts.excerpt: In addition to Pilates, yoga, spinning, wellness, and massage classes.

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Master Suite Nature View has two terraces with a hydromassage tub and views of the resort's gardens.
facts.excerpt: Plus two terraces with a hydromassage tub and views of the resort's exotic gardens.

facts.text: The resort has a kids club.
facts.excerpt: Kids club

facts.text: The hotel calls the YHI Spa a temple of well-being.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to an authentic temple of well-being in the heart of Paradisus Playa del Carmen - Riviera Maya.
